text: # Home FTTH Wi-Fi Router — Setup Guide **Document ID:** MAN_ROUTER_001 **Category:** C25 — Broadband & FTTH Services **Department:** Network **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-06-24 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base --- ## Feature Overview # Home FTTH Wi-Fi Router — Setup Guide **Document ID:** MAN_ROUTER_001 **Category:** C25 — Broadband & FTTH Services **Last Updated:** 2026-06-09 **Version:** 1.0 --- ## Box Contents ONT, Wi-Fi router, power adapters, 1 fibre patch cord, quick-start card. ## Setup Steps 1. Connect the fibre patch cord from the wall outlet to the ONT. 2. Connect ONT to router via the LAN/WAN port using the supplied Ethernet cable. 3. Power on both devices; wait for the PON light to turn steady green. 4. Connect to the default Wi-Fi network printed on the router label and open 192.168.1.1 to set a custom password. ## Troubleshooting See KB_C25_ftth_fault_diagnosis for LOS/red-light issues. ## Prerequisites - A supported device/app version. - An active NovaTel connection registered to your account. ## Step-by-Step Instructions 1. Open the relevant section in the app or device settings. 2. Follow the on-screen prompts to complete setup or configuration. 3. Confirm the feature is active by checking the relevant status indicator. ## Common Errors | Error | Likely Cause | Fix | |---|---|---| | Feature not appearing | App/device not updated | Update to the latest supported version | | Setup fails to complete | Network connectivity issue during setup | Retry on stable Wi-Fi/data | ## Troubleshooting If the above does not
